notes.title: Last blossom 1.04 - minor update
notes.content:
1.04
Just uploaded few minor features and bug fixes:

Features:
1.  FPS lock - Opportunity to control "FPS lock" added to options
2.  Edge scrolling - Now camera can be moved with mouse: simply hover mouth cursor to edges of the screen while in battle.

Bug fixes:
1. Fixed bug when "Roll result" and "Conversation" UI wont appeared after pressing Esc or P in main menu. 
2. FIxed "clicks" in some of the ui sound samples.

Thx

notes.content:

notes.title: Last Blossom in pre-Release!
notes.content:
Hey, stranger!

 Just finished work on Last Blossom!  (Almost).

  [b]last Blossom is a free scene,[/b] meant to be an interactive example of a real tabletop role-playing game! With turn-based combat, ability checks, and critical failures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317434/d96a8d8dbf2b0ccc1f9b8c4e417bfcc7ebdb4731.png[/img]
 [b]Right in May 21[/b], two sides will converge in a tense confrontation for the Last Blossom. They will fight each other not only with force (in a universe where "brave heroes" are not able to move to the diagonall cells!) but rather with diplomacy (and poorly written dialogues!).

 So this scene might try to satisfy a little of your "role-playing hunger" in these ... dark times. Or maybe it will help you to understand a couple of rules, and prepare yourself for a real adventures, that take place in the spicy-smelling old taverns, at an oak tables with some real bone dices rolls.

   Good luck! And stay safe, at least until we meet again!
